title: aeiou parameter file
description: A fragment (params_version 2, contract 0.11, DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78): values for the parameter slots of one abstract, each with its state, `locked` (final), `default` (a value a later layer may replace), or `required` (no value; a later layer must give one), and the runner's identity options in a `run` table. A value has the form of the AST's parameter defaults (a scalar, a distribution, or an array of these) and the kind of the parameter it is for. A use case lists its fragments and `aeiou-params lock` resolves them, by agreement, into a lock; `aeiou run --params-file FILE` applies one over the defaults and under `--param`, several in order, a locked value never replaced.

abstract.description: Name of the abstract this set is for.

ast_sha256.description: When present, the exact AST this set was fitted for; the runner refuses any other.

params.description: Parameter name to its entry. `gpus` may not appear.

run.description: The runner's identity options a use case or a benchmark may set (DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78 point 3): never a solution option, which is always the submitter's. Only a lock's runs apply it; `aeiou run --params-file` refuses a file with one.

provenance.description: How the set was made (tool, source, dates). Never compared.

entry.description: A value with its state: {"default": v}, {"locked": v}, or {"required": true}.
